text: Traffic is prohibited on the Gudauri (Posta)-Kobi section.
Vehicular traffic is prohibited on the Gudauri (Posta)-Kobi section – the Roads Department of the Ministry of Infrastructure of Georgia reports this information.
As noted in the information from the Roads Department, the level of avalanche hazard on the mentioned section is high.

„According to the Roads Department of the Ministry of Infrastructure of Georgia, based on information from the National Environmental Agency, the level of avalanche hazard is high on the Gudauri (Posta)-Kobi section of the Mtskheta-Stepantsminda-Larsi international road, due to which the movement of all types of motor vehicles is temporarily prohibited on the mentioned section.“
"According to the National Environmental Agency, motor vehicle traffic on the Mleta-Gudauri section will be carried out in a non-stop passage mode," – the information states.
